title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5.1, section 10 (Norrish Creek watershed)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5.1 [en. B.C. Reg. 135/2017, App. 1, s. 2.] No Shooting Areas — Specified Crown Land (Section 7.1)
Norrish Creek watershed
10 Those portions of M.U. 2-8 being all Crown land within 400 m of the midline of any road within the Norrish Creek watershed.
